_comment: Lore fragments, shown in the Journal once discovered. Short. Every one raises a question.

moss_frames.title: The Moss Frames
moss_frames.text: Tidy frames of cave moss, each tagged with a date. The oldest tag is forty years old and in a different hand. The moss breathes: on quiet nights you can watch the frames rise and fall, very slightly, in time with nothing you can hear.

first_knock.title: The Pipes, at Night
first_knock.text: Three knocks, a pause, two, a pause, three. Then nothing. Old pipes tick as they cool. These didn't tick. They knocked.

tier1.title: Crew Log, Page Torn
tier1.text: STN-7 inspection, day 4. Lower Stations line holding at 3.1. Askew insists she hears tapping on the second trunk. Coil told her it's thermal. It's thermal. Askew has started tapping back. Coil has told her to stop. — the rest is water-stained

tier2.title: Stores Manifest
tier2.text: GOVERNOR COILS: two (2). One fitted, Station 7 primary. One spare, Trunk chamber, sealed crate. NEVER take the last coil up-line. If the pump dies and the spare is gone, nothing lifts the river. Initialled: W.A.

tier3.title: Station Council Notice
tier3.where: A ruin deep in the Reach
tier3.text: By order of the Station Council: the Trunk Lines are closed to all traffic until the Quiet is understood. Stations will not attempt contact with Lower Stations. Stations will not answer. The brass plate is two hundred years old. Someone has scratched beneath it, much more recently: WE ANSWERED.

trunk.title: A Note in Wren's Hand
trunk.text: B — If you're reading this, you closed it. Good. That's the job, and you did it, so stop that face. The water's going down here. There's air in the lower gallery and a dry stair going further than any map. I can hear pumps below. Running. Somebody is keeping them going. I'm going to find out who. Don't wait up. — W.  3·2·3

relic_crew_locker.title: Crew Locker
relic_crew_locker.text: A crew locker, door rusted half open. A tin cup, a respirator strap gone stiff, and a brass tag on a nail. The name stencilled on the door has been scrubbed off by somebody who meant it.

relic_gauge.title: The Lower Stations Gauge
relic_gauge.text: A pressure gauge with a starred face, plate reading LOWER STATIONS. The needle is pinned past the red. A gauge with nothing behind it reads zero. This one doesn't.

relic_trunk_valve.title: The Trunk Valve
relic_trunk_valve.where: The Sink, beneath the pump hall
relic_trunk_valve.text: A wheel valve the size of a cart wheel, stamped TRUNK — LOWER STATIONS. It's been wired shut with very careful, very even wraps of copper. Someone took their time. Someone didn't want to be quick about it.

relic_stencil.title: Primary Lift
relic_stencil.text: Stencilled on the brick, nearly gone: STN-7 PRIMARY LIFT. There was a lift here once, and it went down. Nobody in Wick remembers it going anywhere.

relic_old_pipes.title: The Old Risers
relic_old_pipes.text: Risers far older than Wick's mains, cast in one piece with no seams. They go down further than the brickwork does, further than the plumb-glass can show.

the_knock.title: Three, Two, Three
the_knock.text: Crew code, Barnaby says. It means: still here. It came back up the Trunk line from somewhere under the Lower Stations, eleven years after anyone should have been there to send it.

quietlight.title: Quietlight
quietlight.text: Every lamp in Wick goes out for one Hush. The glowroots open, the lampmoths rise off the lake, and for an hour everything alive down here is lit by everything else alive down here. How bright depends on the air. Everyone knows that. Everyone acts surprised anyway.

crew_codes.title: Crew Code
crew_codes.text: 3·2·3 still here. 1·1 yes. 2·2 no. 4 come. 3·3 bad air. 1·2·1 how many. 2·1·2 who. 1·3 send. 5 help. Letters: a tap for the row, a tap for the column. 'Nobody uses letters,' Barnaby says. 'Letters are for when you've run out of everything else.'

station_8.title: Pump Log, Station 8
station_8.text: Day 1 of closure. Valve shut at 0400 by Council order. Pressure on the Trunk side holding at 3.4. We can hear Station 9 knocking 3·2·3 through the iron. Council says do not answer. We do not answer. The knocking goes on until 0900. I have stopped writing down how long it goes on.

station_9.title: Seeding Schedule
station_9.where: A ruin in the Lower Stations, Station 9
station_9.text: SCRUBBER MOSS, STRAIN SEVEN. Seed at stations one to forty, in frames, near standing water. Target: damp-cough spore load in station air. Expected self-sustaining within three generations. When established, reopen Trunk Lines in sequence from the Heart. Initialled by eleven station heads, and, at the bottom, by someone who wrote only: 'Somebody tell the gardeners what it's for.'

station_10.title: The Last Bulletin
station_10.text: BREATH INTERVAL NOW 3.2 DAYS (WAS 2.0). HEART OUTPUT FALLING. Recommend Council reconvene and review closure. — There is no reply attached. Under it, in chalk, much later: 'Council's gone. We're still here. — W.A., Sallow.'

council_minutes.title: Council Notice: Closure
council_minutes.text: The damp cough travels with the Breath. Every Trunk carries it. The Council therefore closes the Trunk Lines UNTIL the Strain Seven scrubber moss is established at all forty stations. Stations will not answer knocking. Stations will be patient. — Someone has circled 'until' so hard the pen went through.

heart_manual.title: The Bellows: Restart
heart_manual.text: Restart requires: Trunk pressure from no fewer than one upper station; spore load below threshold in that station's air; the low ways cleared by agreement with the Knappers; the consent of the stations. In the margin: 'Consent of the stations — ha. Good luck, love. — W.'

knapper_agreement.title: The Agreement
knapper_agreement.text: A carving: walkers and Knappers cutting the Trunk together, lamps and hands. At the bottom, a shape like a pair of lungs; at the top, forty little houses. Across the middle, cut much later and much rougher, a stone door, and the Knappers on one side of it with their hands to the rock, listening.

wren_journal.title: B —
wren_journal.text: B — The water went down. I found a stair. You'd hate it. I'm going to see where it goes. ... B — Twelve people and three pumps and a Heart like a sick old dog. I'm staying. ... B — Taught Pell the letters today. Nine years old and better at it than you. ... B — Still here.

deep_pool_0.title: Ration Card, Station 14
deep_pool_0.text: WATER 2L. MEAL 1. AIR: SHARED. Someone has crossed out SHARED and written OURS, and someone else has crossed that out and written SHARED again, harder. The card was never punched.

deep_pool_1.title: The Choir Roster
deep_pool_1.text: Names painted on a wall in two columns, BREATHE IN and BREATHE OUT, and a date for each. Station 19 sang the Bellows' rhythm to its children so they'd sleep in time with it. The last date has only one name under BREATHE IN.

deep_pool_2.title: A Letter Never Sent
deep_pool_2.text: To whoever is in 23. They've closed the Trunk. They say it's for a month. I'll knock on the pipe every night at nine so you know we're still here. Three, two, three. If you hear it, knock back. — R.

deep_pool_3.title: Notice: The Quiet
deep_pool_3.text: BY ORDER OF THE STATION COUNCIL: Trunk Lines CLOSED until further notice. Do not knock. Do not signal. Do not travel. It is kinder this way. The word 'kinder' has been underlined by somebody with a lot of time.

deep_pool_4.title: A Child's Map
deep_pool_4.where: Pinned above a cot, the Unmapped
deep_pool_4.text: Forty circles in crayon, joined by a fat brown line down the middle, and a red heart drawn at the bottom with a smile on it. Every circle has a little face. Somebody has added glasses to the one labelled 'GRANDAD (STATION 31)'.

deep_pool_5.title: Engineer's Log, Station 27
deep_pool_5.text: Day 40 of the Quiet. Pressure holding. Day 140. Pressure holding. Day 900. Pressure holding. Day 3,000. Pressure holding, which means somebody down there is still doing their job. Thank you, whoever you are.

deep_pool_6.title: The Seed Ledger
deep_pool_6.text: Strain 1: ate the spores, and the leaves. Strain 3: ate the spores, and the lichen we eat. Strain 5: ate nothing, sulked. Strain 6: did well; ate the gardener's gloves. Strain 7: — the page is torn out. Someone took it up the Trunk.

deep_pool_7.title: Wedding Ribbon
deep_pool_7.where: Tied to a valve wheel, the Unmapped
deep_pool_7.text: A ribbon, still faintly blue, tied round a valve wheel in a double knot. A tag reads: STATION 33 + STATION 34. MARRIED ACROSS THE TRUNK. The valve is closed. The knot was never undone.

deep_pool_8.title: Count, Station 38
deep_pool_8.where: Chalk on a cavern wall, the Unmapped
deep_pool_8.text: Tally marks in groups of five, eleven rows of them, the chalk getting fainter each row. Under the last row, in a different and steadier hand: 'We went down to the Heart. If you're reading this, so can you.'

deep_pool_9.title: The Builders' Plate
deep_pool_9.where: Set in the rock, the Unmapped
deep_pool_9.text: A brass plate, older than the stations, set into bare rock by hands that didn't need a Council. It says only: WE DUG THIS SO YOU COULD BREATHE. And under that, in Knapper scratches, an older line Grist could read for you: 'We helped.'

deep_pool_10.title: A Recipe Card
deep_pool_10.where: In a dry tin, the Unmapped
deep_pool_10.text: Salt-beet stew, Station 16 style. Beets, salt, whatever's moving. Simmer until the pump changes note. Serve to everyone, including the ones you're cross with, especially them. — Gran Ivy, who was usually cross.

deep_pool_11.title: Last Page of the Manifest
deep_pool_11.where: A clipboard, the very bottom of the Unmapped
deep_pool_11.text: A list of every station, one to forty, and beside each a column headed ANSWERED. Most are blank. Station 11 has a tick in Wren's hand. Beside Station 7, someone has drawn a tick in fresh chalk, and two more stations under it are ticked in handwriting you don't know. Somebody else is reading this list.
